summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Direxion PLTR Defined Income Boost ETF (PLIB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Cboe PLTR Defined Income index. The fund is an income-focused ETF that uses swap contracts to track an index that systematically attempts to produce a target amount of annual income based on selling weekly out-of-the-money call options on the stock of Palantir Technologies Inc., while maintaining upside participation through a daily delta hedging strategy. PLIB was launched on Jul 29, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
